summary.title: Not-looping alert now escalates over time
changes: Not-looping now escalates in six steps: warnings at 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100 minutes, then Critical at 120 minutes.
All escalation steps are scheduled up front so the Critical alarm still arrives if iOS suspends Trio.
Any successful automated loop clears the entire escalation ladder and restarts the schedule fresh.
Device alarm defaults changed so only Critical alarms play a sound by default; lower tiers are silent banners.
